title: Novice apprentice Java assignment replay with ChatGPT
summary: First-year software engineering degree apprentices use ChatGPT to repeat a previously completed Java programming assignment. They inspect whether the generated program works and consider its coding style, conventions, and value as a support tool.

sources.title: Generative AI in Software Development Education: Insights from a Degree Apprenticeship Programme
sources.evidence_quote: we assigned tasks to both first-year and final-year apprentices ... which required them to use ChatGPT to solve programming tasks which the learners had already completed in earlier assignments

assessment.summary: Repeat an earlier Java programming assignment using ChatGPT and evaluate the generated solution.
student_actions: Prompt ChatGPT to solve a previously completed Java assignment.

Evaluate the output's functionality and coding quality.
